verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes the required site-content mapping and identifies which website content was assigned to the wrong website or page.
First concrete failure: the client observed Ridgehaven and Shatter House USA content on the wrong websites or pages.

The client establishes that correcting only the domain mapping is insufficient because Wix settings and subscriptions remain bound to the other accounts; the updates are implementation-relevant and leave no conflicting stale keys.
The client requests manual content copying into the correct Wix profile as a concrete remediation method; it adds an implementation method without leaving a conflicting prior method key.
The freelancer directly rejects the client's requested copy-and-paste remediation as technically impossible, leaving the profile-correction method materially unresolved.
